_comment: SCALE2 (spec/rules/scale.md). Function-form decorationsFacet sources are recomputed in full on every commit. Each entry names the file, the enclosing exported function, why the site may stay function-form, and what closes it: a W-requirement that scopes it, or "permitted" when the cost follows the extension's own state rather than the document. pen/no-unscoped-decoration-source fails an entry whose site no longer exists (I15).

entries.reason: Presentation only: selection context, streaming previews, the generation zone and the inline completion. Suggestion marks moved to a scoped source (W2.R9); what remains follows the active session and generation (SCALE2's state-proportional allowance), not the document.
Remote cursors and selections: cost follows the number of connected peers (SCALE2's state-proportional allowance), not the document.
Decorates the controller's in-memory suggestion list: cost follows the open suggestions (SCALE2's state-proportional allowance), not the document.
Decorates the one visible inline completion: cost follows that completion (SCALE2's state-proportional allowance), not the document.
Decorates the active stream frontier: cost follows the open streams (SCALE2's state-proportional allowance), not the document.
